crossRefs.note: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
Then he brought out the king’s son, and put the crown on him, and gave him the covenant; and they made him king, and…
For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into…
The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.
The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.

translations.web: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
translations.bsb: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy
translations.kjv: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
translations.asv: Let the floods clap their hands; Let the hills sing for joy together
